help.tips[0].examples[1].en: Switch the device off and on again!

help.tips[0].en.title: The verbs — mostly separable
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: My battery is flat and the Wi-Fi isn't working.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: The file is on the hard drive, but the program will not start.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: It is der Akku, a masculine noun, so the nominative article is der.
help.tips[1].en.text: der Computer, der Laptop, der Bildschirm, der Akku, der Drucker · die App, die E-Mail, die Datei, die Nachricht, die Festplatte, die Website · das Handy, das Gerät, das Passwort, das WLAN, das Programm.
help.tips[1].en.title: The nouns and their genders
help.tips[1].en.trap: das Handy is a mobile phone (not 'handy'); der Akku is a rechargeable battery (die Batterie is disposable); die Festplatte is the hard drive. And 'aktuell' means current, not actual.
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: My computer keeps crashing – I have to restart it.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: I have forgotten my password. – Then click on "reset password".
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: Programs crash with abstürzen: das Programm stürzt ab.
help.tips[2].en.text: Der Bildschirm bleibt schwarz. Das Programm stürzt ab (crashes). Die Verbindung ist weg. Ich habe das Passwort vergessen. — neu starten (restart), aktualisieren, den Kundendienst anrufen.
help.tips[2].en.title: Problems and fixes
help.tips[3].examples[1].en: I download the app and upload the photos.
help.tips[3].check.whyEn: Putting something online is going up: hochladen = upload. herunterladen is download.
help.tips[3].en.text: herunterladen (load down), hochladen (load up). Picture the arrows; the English 'download / upload' is the same pair.
help.tips[3].en.title: herunter / hoch = down / up
help.vocab[4].en: to switch off / to switch on
help.context.en: Yesterday I wanted to upload a photo, but the website wouldn't load. At first I thought the Wi-Fi was broken. Then I saw: the battery was almost flat and the device had switched itself off. I switched it on again, entered my password, saved the photo once more – and suddenly everything worked.
help.mistakes[0].whyEn: herunterladen is the standard verb; the participle is heruntergeladen.
help.mistakes[1].whyEn: A rechargeable battery is der Akku.
help.hookEn: Download, save, switch it off and on again: the German words you need when your phone or laptop acts up.
help.introEn: Medien und Technik is a theme you talk about every day, and its vocabulary is unusual in one way: much of it is English, but not the way you'd guess. Some words are borrowed whole and given a gender (der Computer, das Handy — which is not English at all —, die App, der Laptop, die E-Mail, das WLAN for Wi-Fi); some are German verbs built on the borrowed nouns (downloaden and herunterladen both exist, but herunterladen is the standard; speichern = save, drucken = print, klicken, hochladen = upload, ausschalten / einschalten = switch off/on); and some are plain German with no English echo at all (der Bildschirm = screen, das Gerät = device, das Passwort, der Akku = battery, die Datei = file, die Nachricht = message, die Festplatte = hard drive). Learn the verbs with their separable prefixes: Ich lade die App herunter; Schalte das Gerät aus.
help.rememberEn[0]: speichern – drucken – herunterladen – ausschalten: the four verbs of every tech dialogue.
help.rememberEn[1]: das Handy, der Akku, die Festplatte: German words in English clothing.
sentences[0].whyEn: speichern — files get stored; der Speicher is a storeroom.
sentences[1].whyEn: herunterladen — literally 'load down', the German for download.
sentences[2].whyEn: die Nachricht — the message; also the TV news (Nachrichten).
sentences[3].whyEn: das Gerät — any technical device, from phone to washing machine.
sentences[4].whyEn: die Datei — from Daten (data); not das Datum (the date)!
sentences[6].whyEn: das Passwort — the word that lets you pass.
sentences[7].whyEn: drucken — with u; drücken with ü means 'to press'.
sentences[8].whyEn: das WLAN — the German word for Wi-Fi, said 'vay-lan'.
sentences[9].whyEn: der Akku — short for Akkumulator; Batterie is the throwaway kind.
sentences[10].whyEn: die E-Mail — feminine in German, by analogy with die Post.
sentences[11].whyEn: klicken — auf etwas klicken, with auf + accusative.
sentences[12].whyEn: hochladen — 'load up', the counterpart of herunterladen.
sentences[13].whyEn: ausschalten is separable: the aus waits at the end of the sentence.
sentences[14].whyEn: die Website — or, Germanised, die Webseite.
sentences[15].whyEn: ausmachen — separable, the aus closes the sentence.
sentences[16].whyEn: löschen → gelöscht — löschen also means putting out a fire.
